visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of a glass-fronted warming display at a supermarket. Inside, several large roasted sweet potatoes with browned, textured skins rest on a metal rack above a bed of smooth, rounded black stones. A hand reaches into the frame to touch one of the potatoes. (2) The scene cuts to a medium close-up of a young man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a grey sleeveless athletic shirt with the brand name 'AROO'. He holds a large, charred roasted sweet potato vertically in front of his face, showing its length compared to his head. (3) The man opens his mouth wide and takes a substantial bite from the top of the sweet potato, revealing the bright yellow and soft interior. He has an enthusiastic expression. (4) A close-up shot follows, focusing on the bitten sweet potato held in a white paper bag. The interior flesh looks moist and steaming, contrasting with the dark, crispy skin. (5) The final shot is a low-angle exterior view of a tall, blue and red 'PX Mart' (全聯) commercial sign mounted on the side of a building, with Chinese characters indicating the 'Dazhi Mingshui' branch.
